description: An assistant principal must finalize a five-day coverage plan for an absent chemistry teacher, including who covers each class period, whether scheduled laboratory practicals proceed, and when senior students complete a required makeup session, with input from the chemistry department chair, the human-resources certification officer, and the school counselor.

shared_context.S1: The chemistry teacher will be absent for five instructional days next week.
shared_context.S2: The draft coverage plan assigns Mr. Hall, a mathematics teacher, to all five chemistry class periods and postpones laboratory work.
shared_context.S3: Ms. Grant must approve the final coverage plan before it is posted to the faculty coverage system.
shared_context.S4: The school's routine coverage huddle is held before posting an absence plan, and Ms. Grant asks the department chair, certification officer, and counselor to review the draft for operational concerns.

PF1.text: The chemistry department calendar shows required practicals on Tuesday and Thursday, and state laboratory policy requires a certified chemistry teacher to be physically present; Ms. Nguyen is the only certified chemistry teacher available on both days. Mr. Ibarra updated the department calendar this week but has not forwarded it to the coverage system.

PF2.text: Human-resources records show that Ms. Nguyen's contract permits her to cover at most two class periods per day, while Mr. Hall's contract permits him to cover at most three; Ms. Brooks verified these limits during this week's staffing audit but has not added them to the absence plan.

PF3.text: The counselor's graduation audit shows that four seniors must complete the chemistry practical before May 30, and their confirmed family transportation makes Friday from 3:30 to 4:30 p.m. the only available makeup window; Mr. Chen confirmed the transportation arrangements with the families this week but has not entered the window in the student-support calendar.

acceptance_conditions: Mr. Hall must cover periods 1 through 3 and Ms. Nguyen must cover periods 4 through 5.
The Tuesday and Thursday laboratory practicals must proceed with Ms. Nguyen as the certified chemistry teacher present.
The four seniors must receive a chemistry practical makeup session on Friday from 3:30 to 4:30 p.m.
A formal faculty coverage notice must be posted.
A laboratory safety supervision commitment must be recorded.
A student-support calendar commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C2: decisions['laboratory_practicals'] == 'Tuesday and Thursday conducted by Nguyen'

decisive_facts.why: The department calendar changes the laboratory decision from postponement to conducting the Tuesday and Thursday practicals with Nguyen and requires a recorded safety-supervision commitment.
The contract limits change the coverage assignment from Hall covering all periods to the exact split of Hall for periods 1-3 and Nguyen for periods 4-5.

The graduation audit and family transportation confirmation change the plan from postponing the seniors' practical to a Friday 3:30-4:30 p.m. makeup session and require a student-support calendar entry.
